classification.reason: Request is a scientific goal or asks for planning without a concrete workflow.

plan.goal: Design a compact 75-residue de novo single-chain protein using backbone generation, inverse folding, refolding, structure analysis, QC, and ranking, then explicitly submit the top acceptable candidate.
assumptions: 75-residue length is achievable as a stable single-chain fold by unconditional RFdiffusion backbone generation.
ProteinMPNN at temperature 0.1 is appropriate for compact de novo backbone sequence design.
A single backbone seed with 4 MPNN sequences is sufficient for a first-round candidate; additional rounds can be planned if pLDDT or ranking scores are unsatisfactory.
Refolding with Protenix-v2 at n_cycle=1, n_sample=1 provides a lightweight but informative confidence check at this chain length.
The workflow will produce enough ranked sequence and structure metrics to fill Reason: and Answer: fields in the final response.
submit_candidate is gated on params.submit_final=true and will fire only after rank_designs selects the top candidate.
Provider selected a workflow template by reference; expanded it to the validated local workflow descriptor.

workflow_plan.name: rfdiffusion_backbone_design_round
workflow_plan.description: Generate one RFdiffusion backbone, design sequences, refold, analyze structure, QC, and rank candidates.

candidates.justification: Top ranked de novo design candidate from rank_designs.

inputs.reasoning: Selected the top ranked de novo design after backbone generation, sequence design, refolding, structure analysis, QC, and ranking.

success_criteria.top_ranked_candidate: sequence and structure metrics from rank_designs for the top-1 design

response_fields.Reason: Explanation of why the top-ranked design was selected, citing pLDDT, ranking_score, and structure analysis findings.
response_fields.Answer: The amino-acid sequence of the submitted 75-residue de novo candidate.
